critical_code_review_comments: refinement_routes.REFEREE_QUESTIONS has exactly 4 items {capacity, reliability, strengths, teamwork} — spec-aligned. RECOMMEND_QUESTION includes both {candidate} and {org} placeholders substituted at GET time. Confirmed via TestRefereeFormShape.

refinement_routes.submit_referee_form correctly enforces (in order): every question answered, recommend in {'Yes','No','I would need more information to say'}, explanation required, declaration_confirmed required — all four returning 422 with descriptive detail messages.

refinement_routes.submit_candidate_form saves references with status='Ready to Contact' and does NOT auto-email referees. Founder notification 'References Submitted | <candidate>' sent via notify_owner() with 'Review References' button linking to /app/recruitment/self-guided/module/4. Verified DB state + no referee sent_at.

refinement_routes.resend_referee (POST /workspace/reference-process/{id}/resend-referee/{ref_id}) sends the referee email with subject 'Reference Request | <candidate> — <org> Board Application' and sets references.$.status='Sent' + sent_at + process.status='In Progress'.
refinement_routes.send_candidate_form subject built as f'Reference Information Needed | {org} Board Application' — matches spec exactly.

opportunity_emails.opportunity_email_html: subject 'Board Leadership Opportunity | <org>', body opens with FIRST_NAME merge + 'I'm currently supporting <org>' Rooney voice intro, mission block, expertise <ul><li> list from candidate_needs (up to 10), Apply Here CTA with real URL, view-opportunity link, signs 'Rooney Akpesiri / The Nonprofit Board Builder'. No [TEST MODE], no [Application Link], no [APPLICATION LINK].

opportunity_emails.send_opportunity_broadcast test-mode subject prefixed with '[Owner Preview] ' (not '[TEST MODE]') and sent only to OWNER_TEST_EMAIL when BOARD_APPLICANT_OPPORTUNITY_EMAILS_LIVE=false. Live mode uses Resend merge tokens {{{current_opportunity_apply_url}}} and {{{FIRST_NAME|there}}} for one broadcast body per campaign.

workspace_routes.candidate_decision idempotently creates reference_process (status 'Not Started') and Ready-for-Signature signature_requests per approved agreement + board_profile_link. Verified 200 + prepared payload.

workspace_routes.conditional_offer generation (lines 219-288) injects onboarding session details, real /sign/<token> + /board-profile/<token> links, and background/reference status into context — with prompt-side instruction to only include ACTUALLY outstanding conditions. Not executed live to preserve Claude budget; code path reviewed.

ai_service GENERATION_TYPES: conditional_offer subject 'Congratulations! Your Conditional Appointment as ...' with strict body instructions (candidate-specific WHY paragraphs, ONLY outstanding conditions, real onboarding details, distinction between REVIEW vs SIGN links). organization_overview + board_manual (titled 'Board Member Manual') + 3 agreements all carry explicit 'NEVER invent ...' clauses and 'omit unsupported sections' guidance — spec-aligned.
